lead: A `?T` variable narrowed by `if ($x != null)` is nullable again inside a `while` or `foreach` in that block, so `$x->member()` there is `E0459`.
body: `crates/nvs-types/src/locals.rs` drops every narrowing made outside a loop body, and one made by an early `return` on `null` is dropped the same way. Bind the narrowed value to a non-null variable before the loop, `Core\Ldap\Entry $person = $found;`, and use that inside it.
